SNOWFLAKE FOR FINANCIAL SERVICES

## Frequently Asked Questions

Commonly asked questions and their answers to support your data and AI journey with Snowflake.

What are the advantages of cloud solutions for financial services?

With cloud solutions, your team can easily build an enterprise data and AI strategy that connects your silos, support data and compute across the cloud, streamline access of multi-modal data and offer fully managed AI services and tools.

You can also power business-critical use cases with enterprise data access by unlocking storage interoperability and tapping into an ecosystem of best-of-breed data, AI and applications.

Entrust your most sensitive data to Snowflake with confidence thanks to its fully unified security and governance controls, as well as cross-cloud resiliency for business continuity and disaster recovery.

What are the use cases supported by data and AI in financial services?

Data and AI power a wide range of critical use cases across financial services. For investment and markets, firms use the AI Data Cloud for quantitative research, investment analytics, and institutional client services. In risk and compliance, AI is key for dynamic risk management, regulatory reporting, and combating financial crimes like fraud, KYC, and AML. Insurance providers use AI for underwriting and claims management to improve efficiency. Finally, a comprehensive Customer 360 view enables personalized services and stronger client relationships on a unified data foundation.

How is artificial intelligence applied in the financial services industry?

1. AI helps accelerate the ingestion, transformation, and optimization of both structured and unstructured data — allowing organizations to broaden their data aperture and take advantage of the wealth of multimodal data across the enterprise.

2. AI drives efficiencies and trust across existing use cases by automating traditionally manual, and oftentimes error prone tasks and workflows.

3. AI democratizes access to data, insights and analytics by enabling users to use natural language to ask questions and talk to their data.

What are financial services-specific security and compliance standards that Snowflake supports?

Snowflake supports customers’ compliance with several key security and compliance standards relevant to the financial services industry, including:

- EU DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act): DORA aims to strengthen the digital operational resilience of the European financial sector.

- ISO 27001: This is a globally recognized standard for information security management systems (ISMS).

- ISO 42001: ISO 42001 is the first international management system standard for artificial intelligence.

- SOC 1 & SOC 2: These are audit reports that provide assurance to customers about the effectiveness of a service organization's controls related to financial reporting (SOC 1) and security, availability, and confidentiality (SOC 2).

- Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS): This standard regulates companies that process, store or transmit credit card information, and requires companies to maintain a secure environment.

- C5 (Cloud Computing Compliance Controls Catalog): This German standard for cloud computing providers addresses security and data protection for cloud services.

What types of verticals within financial services are supported by cloud solutions?

Cloud solutions support a wide range of verticals within the financial services industry, including buy-side firms such as asset management, sovereign wealth funds, wealth management, private equity and hedge funds.

On the sell-side, they are used by retail and commercial banks, investment banks and brokerage firms. Cloud technology is also widely adopted across the insurance sector, serving property and casualty, life and annuities, and re-insurance companies.

Additionally, payments companies, exchanges, data providers, and fintechs all leverage cloud solutions to drive innovation and efficiency.

How does Snowflake integrate with my existing technical stack?

Snowflake is compatible with many best-of-breed industry solutions, many of which are accessible via [native apps](https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/features/native-apps/) and connectors in [Snowflake Marketplace](https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/features/marketplace/).
